experience.detail: Final-year ICT student, open to internship and graduate roles.

home.heroBlurb: ICT graduate building across software, Android, databases, IT support and networking. One developer, five ways to hire.
home.about: I'm a final-year ICT student at the University of Mpumalanga. I move comfortably between frontend, backend, mobile, databases and networks, and build in whichever track a role calls for.
home.aboutDark: Final-year ICT student, comfortable moving between frontend, backend, mobile, databases and networking, building in whichever track a role calls for.

stokvault.name: StokVault
stokvault.subtitle: Stokvel Contribution & Payout Platform
stokvault.description: Replaces WhatsApp and notebook record-keeping for stokvels with one auditable system. Treasurers verify contributions per cycle, a batch job checks payout eligibility, high-value payouts need a second approver, and every financial action lands in a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log.

taskify.name: Taskify
taskify.subtitle: Campus Task & Equipment Marketplace
taskify.description: Post tasks, hire services and rent equipment inside a secure campus marketplace. JWT auth, a full task lifecycle, booking and return tracking, ratings and simulated escrow payments.

healthwise.name: HealthWise
healthwise.subtitle: AI Symptom Checker
healthwise.description: Matches selected symptoms to possible conditions using an AI API, with an interactive chatbot, Room-backed history and AlarmManager pill reminders.

fuelsa.name: FUEL SA
fuelsa.subtitle: Fuel Station Management
fuelsa.description: Desktop station management with a JavaFX GUI, built on OOP principles with clean separation of logic, controllers and UI.

ump-events.name: UMP Events
ump-events.subtitle: Campus Event Booking Website
ump-events.description: Students register, browse upcoming campus events and book a seat, then view their bookings from a profile page. Admins create and remove events with images, dates and capacity. Built on PHP and MySQL with hashed passwords, prepared statements and role-based access.

networking-wan.name: Two-Campus WAN
networking-wan.subtitle: Design & Configuration
networking-wan.description: Two campuses with five departments each, separate student, staff and guest wireless networks, and inter-campus connectivity verified with ping tests.

stams.name: STAMS
stams.subtitle: Student Accommodation Management
stams.description: Landlords manage properties, rooms and the students living in them. Students report maintenance issues with photos and can nudge a landlord when an issue stalls, and both sides are notified as it moves from Reported to Resolved.

software.label: Software Developer
software.headline: Software Developer
software.tagline: I build full-stack web applications end to end, from the database up through the API to the interface.
software.summary: Final-year ICT student majoring in Application Development at the University of Mpumalanga. I enjoy solving real-world problems through code and designing systems that make people's lives easier.

android.label: Android Developer
android.headline: Android Developer
android.tagline: I design and build native Android apps with clean architecture and a smooth, reliable user experience.
android.summary: Native Android applications with clean, maintainable code, from UI layouts to local data storage.

database.label: Database Developer
database.headline: Database Developer
database.tagline: I model, normalize, and optimize relational databases so applications stay fast and data stays consistent.
database.summary: From ER models to normalised schemas and well-indexed queries: data that holds up as the application grows.

helpdesk.label: IT Help Desk
helpdesk.headline: IT Support Technician
helpdesk.tagline: I diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and user-facing technical issues quickly and clearly.
helpdesk.summary: Calm, methodical troubleshooting with clear communication, getting people back to work fast.

networking.label: Networking
networking.headline: Network Support Technician
networking.tagline: I configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, from subnetting to routing and switching.
networking.summary: Designing addressing schemes, segmenting with VLANs and verifying connectivity across sites.
